A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect the electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.

Complete maintenance tool 
 set.
Cleaning fluid - ropes

Vibrometer, feeler gauge, 
 dial indicator
Check discharge pressure and compare them with the setting value.
Check vibration level and record it.
Shutdown the pump.
Measure alignment and record it.
Drain the oil from discharge pipe.
Pull out the knock pins and take off the motor
Draw the coupling of pump side
Remove the discharge pipe ( discharge line to base plate )
Take off V- ring (27), base cover (29) and slinger
Be careful pull out the pump from take and make the bottom up
Dismantle the discharge pipe and the pressure gauge pipe
Dismantle the strainer (12) and suction cover (11) from casing (6)
Loosen the impeller nut (2) after straiten the nail of washer (42)
Dismantle the impeller (1) from the shaft and remove the key (4)
Remove the neck bush (9)
Remove the support pipe and bearing housing with shaft from base plate.
Dismantle the bearing cover (17)
Remove the shaft with the ball bearing (14) from the bearing housing
Loosen the bearing nut (16) after straiten the nail of washer (15)
Draw the ball bearing from the shaft
Check the clearance between neck bush and shaft ( 0.08 0.15 mm )
Check the clearance between impeller and wearing ( 0.32 0.4 mm )
Check the impeller anti worn, check the dust and foreign matter in oil
Check the ball bearing renew it ( if it is needed)
Mount the ball bearing, screw the bearing nut
Insert the shaft with ball bearing in the bearing housing
Assemble the bearing cover (17)
Assemble the support pipe and bearing housing with the shaft to base plate
Mount the neck bush (9)

Mount the key (4), assemble the impeller with the shaft, screw it with the 
 impeller nut (2)
Assemble the strainer (12) and suction cover (11) with casing (6)
Connect the discharge pipe and pressure gauge pipe
Put the pump in the take
Mount V- ring and assemble the base cover
Connect the discharge pipe
Assemble the coupling of the pump side
Put the motor on it's place and make alignment, retighten the base plate
Direction of rotation of the motor
Be sure that the pump turn lightly and smoothly
Check the liquid level if the pump casing is immersed perfectly in liquid
Discharge pressure and quantity and record it
Vibration level and record it

Introduction
This document outlines 
 the major maintenance procedures P1, to be performed every four years as 
 indicated by Y4 in the above title block.
DC emergency oil pump is 
 used to feed emergency oil to journal bearing of turbine and generator.
The first draft initiated 
 & tested by eng. Abdel Alim Abd El-Aal El-desoky, reviewed by eng. Sobhy Abel 
 Halim, and approved by eng. Mohamed Abd Elghaffar general director of Al-Arish 
 PS
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy,

Work to be carried out
Before Pump Shutdown
Check discharge pressure and compare them with the setting value.
Check vibration level and record it.
Shutdown the pump.
Measure alignment and record it.
Drain the oil from discharge pipe.
Disassembly 
(Refer to Fig. 1)
Pull out the knock pins and take off the motor
Draw the coupling of pump side
Remove the discharge pipe ( discharge line to base plate )
Take off V- ring (27), base cover (29) and slinger
Be careful pull out the pump from take and make the bottom up
Dismantle the discharge pipe and the pressure gauge pipe
Dismantle the strainer (12) and suction cover (11) from casing (6)
Loosen the impeller nut (2) after straiten the nail of washer (42)
Dismantle the impeller (1) from the shaft and remove the key (4)
Remove the neck bush (9)
Remove the support pipe and bearing housing with shaft from base plate.
Dismantle the bearing cover (17)
Remove the shaft with the ball bearing (14) from the bearing housing
Loosen the bearing nut (16) after straiten the nail of washer (15)
Draw the ball bearing from the shaft
Inspection
Check the clearance between neck bush and shaft ( 0.08 0.15 mm )
Check the clearance between impeller and wearing ( 0.32 0.4 mm )
Check the impeller anti worn, check the dust and foreign matter in oil
Check the ball bearing renew it ( if it is needed)
Assembly 
(Refer to Fig. 1)
Mount the ball bearing, screw the bearing nut
Insert the shaft with ball bearing in the bearing housing
Assemble the bearing cover (17)
Assemble the support pipe and bearing housing with the shaft to base plate
Mount the neck bush (9)
Mount the key (4), assemble the impeller with the shaft, screw it with the 
 impeller nut (2)
Assemble the strainer (12) and suction cover (11) with casing (6)
Connect the discharge pipe and pressure gauge pipe
Put the pump in the take
Mount V- ring and assemble the base cover
Connect the discharge pipe
Assemble the coupling of the pump side
Put the motor on it's place and make alignment, retighten the base plate
Pump Start up
Direction of rotation of the motor
Be sure that the pump turn lightly and smoothly
Check the liquid level if the pump casing is immersed perfectly in liquid
Attendance and Checking During 
Operation
Discharge pressure and quantity and record it
Vibration level and record it
